[SWS_DM_00126] Realisation of
UDS
service 0x3E TesterPresent
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04198
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall internally implement the diagnostic ser-
vice 0x3E TesterPresent according to ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
7.3.2.8.22 Service 0x85 – ControlDTCSetting
The UDS service ControlDTCSetting is used by a client to stop or resume the updating
of DTC status bits in the server.
The ControlDTCSetting service in ISO 14229-1[1] allows the optional parameter DTC-
SettingControlOptionRecord. The
Diagnostic Server instance
always sup-
ports this parameter. This effectively means that a ControlDTCSetting service with
or without DTCSettingControlOptionRecord is processed in the same way. As defined
in [SWS_DM_00231] the DTCSettingControlOptionRecord is limited to the one and
only 0xFFFFFF value.
